svg.title: Post-training success across 15 task and backbone settings
svg.desc: The exact success values from paper Table I for Offline BC, Human-Gated DAgger, Diff-DAgger and TimelyDAgger. TimelyDAgger has the highest reported result in 13 of 15 settings. All x axes run from zero to 100 percent.
